summary_en: 850,000 shares (1.36% of shares outstanding), ¥1,000M ceiling, open-market acquisition, Aug 1–Sep 30, 2026. Rationale: improved capital efficiency and enhanced shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, JBCC Holdings' board resolved to acquire treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company is authorized to acquire up to 850,000 ordinary shares (1.36% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for an aggregate maximum of ¥1,000 million. Acquisitions will be conducted via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over the period from 1 August to 30 September 2026. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital-allocation responses to changing business conditions, while enhancing shareholder returns. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 8,463,631 treasury shares against 62,631,341 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
